defs.def: excellent; very good 极佳的；非常好的

ex.s: When ____14____(see) from afar, the mangrove forests appear more splendid.
ex.t: 当从远处____14__(see)时，红树林看起来更加壮观。

ex.s: For many British people, that can apply to institutions and objects that represent their country’s past-age-old castles, splendid homes… and red phone boxes.
The real McNay was splendid， but we felt nervous the whole time we were there． Van Gogh， Picasso． This time， we stayed together， in case anything else unusual happened．
ex.t: "那是我的家。我当时是个青少年，坐在大厅里。在你们过来之前，我从未意识到我住的地方多么美丽。我以前从未觉得自己幸运。你们以为它是博物馆。那次经历之后我对家的感觉改变了。我一直想感谢你们。"

defs.def: very impressive; very beautiful 壮丽的；雄伟的；豪华的；华丽的

ex.s: Therefore, in order to please them, foreign envoys presented these emperors with the most intricate and splendid timepieces.
ex.t: 因此，为了取悦他们，外国使节向这些皇帝进献了最精密、最华丽钟表。

ex.s: Then at night, see the splendid Journey of Lights Parade and fireworks display.
ex.t: 然后夜晚，观看壮丽的灯光游行和烟花表演。

ex.s: All things considered, though, it must be one of the most beautiful and splendid films ever made.Although it is in black and white, the striking use of light makes it seem at times like a moving painting.
ex.t: 不过，综合来看，它一定是有史以来最美丽、最辉煌的电影之一。虽然是黑白的，但引人注目的光影运用使它有时看起来像一幅流动的画。

ex.s: One truly unique scenic spot in Canada is the mighty Niagara Falls with water rushing over its edge in a splendid display of sights and sounds.
ex.t: 加拿大一个真正独特的景点是壮观的尼亚加拉大瀑布，水流轰鸣着从边缘倾泻而下，呈现出壮丽的视觉与听觉盛宴。

ex.s: Splendid as the view of the Earth is, spacewalking is not as exciting as you might think.
ex.t: 虽然从太空俯瞰地球的景色很壮观，但太空行走并不像你想象的那么刺激。
